sentences.text: In the city of Neutropolis, emotions are a crime.
They stop love, anger, and joy.
But one boy, Leo, is different.
She works at the government office.
She takes her pills every day.
But one day, he finds something strange.
He sees a group of kids.
The government does not like this.
He wants to know their secret.
The next day, Leo goes to the park again.
Leo feels joy for the first time.
As they play, Leo learns their secret.
He wants to be a part of this.
But soon, Leo learns something scary.
The government knows about the Feelers.
They send agents to find them.
Should he fight against the system?
Or should he go back to being quiet?
They want to show the world that feelings are good.
They want to tell everyone the truth.
On the day of the meeting, many people come.
They listen to Leo and the Feelers.
He knows he made the right choice.
And now, the world is changing.
